test_title: PYST 12: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.

The frequency of large wildfires ______ dramatically in recent decades.
solution:
The correct answer is "**has increased**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in the present perfect tense,
 
• **The structure of the sentence in present perfect tense is: subject+ have/has + past participle/V-ed. **
 
• **Now, in the given sentence, "has" is required before the past participle form of the main verb.**
